grid.cell_id: row * 720 + col; row = floor((90 - lat) / 0.5); col = floor((lon + 180) / 0.5)
grid.lat_lon: cell centre; cell spans lat +-0.25, lon +-0.25

meta.layout: columnar: every array has n_cells entries, same index = same cell

filter_semantics.quality / scores: 0 on cells that are not a site for that application
